name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 54 – Am 11
title: REPORT on a revamped long-term budget for the Union in a changing world
part_text: 54a. Stresses the failure of European policies to prevent migratory flows and human trafficking; reiterates its concerns regarding the role played by instruments such as the Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund in managing the effects of the refugee and migrant crisis; underlines that appropriations should be reallocated to repatriation and border security;
